challenges.name: invoice-integer-money
challenges.title: Mini project: build the invoice with integer money
challenges.description: Hồ Gươm Books sells e-books abroad in USD, and its invoices and card charges disagreed by a few cents because prices went through floats. Build the invoice with integer cents: parse prices and percentages from strings without any float, apply an order discount and the VAT of each line in basis points, round every line half up to a whole cent, format amounts with two decimals, and reject malformed amounts and percents with a clear error. The test runner reads the items and the discount and prints your invoice.

item 1 19.99 10 Clean Code (ebook)

Atomic Habits (ebook): 3 x 4.35 = 13.05

total: 36.98
